hint: WASD to walk  ·  E to look at something  ·  the boardwalk out is south

spots.line: The hut stands on legs. The legs stand in water. Nobody looks at the legs.
Eel traps, a dozen of them, all set and all empty.
A ledger of tide marks cut into a post, going back further than the post should.
The boards give under you and settle again. They have been giving for years.

chests.line: A crock under the boards, roped to a leg so the water cannot take it.

people.name: Ossa of the Stilts
chatter: Built it on legs because the water comes up. It comes up further every year.
I read the traps, not the sky. The traps are honest.
Sit where I say. Some of these boards are a courtesy, not a floor.
You want something. Everyone who walks a bog wants something.

people.name: a heron on the rail
chatter: It has the rail and it is not sharing the rail.
